# kind glob: # Which events of the event log become a push message (scripts/event-notify.sh calls `hs notify` for the first row that matches).
# kind      a kind or a glob over kinds ("ext.media.sabnzbd.*"); the first matching row wins. Kinds that start with notify. never match.
# category  the notify category (alarm lock problem ok start stop info), or "-": matched and silent (a way to mute a kind)
# priority  min low default high urgent, or "-" for the default of the category
# title, message   text with {key} places: a key of the payload, or kind, subject, level, text of the row; an unknown key is empty; a backslash and n is a new line
# Drop-in files: every *.tsv in /var/lib/hs/notify-rules.d (HS_NOTIFY_RULES_DIR) is read first, in name order, so a package or the owner
# can add rows or override one of these. docs/notify-rules.md. Not listed on purpose: job.failed (hs-notify-failure@ tells it) and
# storage.pool-fault (scripts/zed-event.sh tells it), they would be told twice.
